records.selectedConstraintOrHeldFinding: Preserve the four Astral Projection school placements and four actual class-school routes, rank9/class17/base26RP/Action/120feet/V-S-F/Instantaneous. Illusion placement grants no additional class route. Imprisonment is not adjudicated.

Do not identify Astral with Radiant Currents, Boundless Void, Interstice or viewer geometry. The native destination remains Astral, but no operational site/arrival geometry is selected without supporting facts or authorization. Mortal Astral labels/sites remain preserved, not declared fictitious.

Propose a declared willing cohort including the caster and individually recorded companions; preserve 120-foot selection reach. Select no fixed participant cap and no hostile projection. Admission of unconscious, summoned, incorporeal or already projected recipients remains held with the actual body model; no automatic party/owner test.

No original/projected-body model is selected from the word projection alone. Require one actor identity with explicit per-body locations, anatomy, needs, awareness, vulnerability and control. Neither an independent copied character nor a generic local scene projection is authorized.

Require exact item/body allocation and custody before approving entry or return. No item, ammunition, charge, component, cargo or carried creature is duplicated. Whether a possession stays, travels or is represented remains unresolved; do not invent projected matter.

Select conservation of one actor resource/history/action schedule as a proposed constraint; do not allocate a second RP, HP, rest, concentration or cast-history pool. Actual body-local damage/condition mapping remains unresolved.

Keep Core Instantaneous as printed initiation metadata. Do not infer eight-hour casting, ritual costs, one-minute duration, concentration or permanence. Continuing relation and individual/cohort endpoints require an explicit supported spell-local contract.

No actual arrival, travel speed, flight, breathing, navigation, onward-plane transit or universal destination knowledge is inferred. A specific useful source-qualified Astral arrival/action witness is still required.

Do not freeze or reset outside, Opening2400-hour, Horn1200-hour, rest or source-duration clocks. No Astral time conversion is selected; both elapsed timelines must be supplied before an encounter can be certified.

Keep real recipient lifecycle and independent source ending separate. Null scene-projection or companion endpoints do not classify Astral participants. Injury/0HP/death/healing/Hunt/return consequences require the explicit body relation; no immortality or automatic safe return.

Evaluate actual source loci and exact endpoint predicates only after the projection transaction/body model exists. Dimensional Anchor is not a generic cage or spell suppression; no universal exemption or total blocking rule is invented.

Require stable original-body identity, legal return fit and finite terminal/cargo resolution for moved, confined, lost, dead or destroyed original bodies. No Banishment/Transport6 terminal exception is borrowed. Repeated cleanup must not duplicate identity/items or refund costs.

Require explicit same-participant overlap/replacement and per-member control/return policy. No new telepathy, possession, omniscient map or extra independent schedule. Neither a fixed cohort cap nor a second simultaneous body relation is adopted.

Preserve the actual comparison scopes; their status labels do not establish Astral body/arrival/return mechanics. A useful paid Astral encounter, one actor schedule, outside clocks and conserved custody remain required. No shared soul/stasis/terminal-rescue rule is adopted.

Astral per-body paid-action history remains incomplete until the projection relation is specified. Original-body confinement, corpse/gear, fit and partial suppression require actual source-qualified branch inputs. No Imprisonment ruling is made.

note: 13 original/shared target questions plus two focused addenda preserved; historical pair wording stays in evidence, current rulings are Astral-only.
